options.name: access_token
options.description: An OAuth2 access token if credential type is accesstoken.

options.name: app_engine_http_target
options.description: App Engine HTTP target. If the job providers a App Engine HTTP target the cron will send a request to the service instance .

options.name: attempt_deadline
options.description: The deadline for job attempts. If the request handler does not respond by this deadline then the request is cancelled and the attempt is marked as a DEADLINE_EXCEEDED failure. The failed attempt can be viewed in execution logs. Cloud Scheduler will retry the job according to the RetryConfig. The allowed duration for this deadline is: * For HTTP targets, between 15 seconds and 30 minutes. * For App Engine HTTP targets, between 15 seconds and 24 hours. * **Note**: For PubSub targets, this field is

options.name: description
options.description: A human-readable description for the job. This string must not contain more than 500 characters.

options.name: env_type
options.description: Specifies which Ansible environment you're running this module within. This should not be set unless you know what you're doing. This only alters the User Agent string for any API requests.

options.name: http_target
options.description: HTTP target. If the job providers a http_target the cron will send a request to the targeted url .

options.name: project
options.description: The Google Cloud Platform project to use.

options.name: pubsub_target
options.description: Pub/Sub target If the job providers a Pub/Sub target the cron will publish a message to the provided topic .

options.name: region
options.description: Region where the scheduler job resides .

options.name: retry_config
options.description: By default, if a job does not complete successfully, meaning that an acknowledgement is not received from the handler, then it will be retried with exponential backoff according to the settings .

options.name: schedule
options.description: Describes the schedule on which the job will be executed.

options.name: scopes
options.description: Array of scopes to be used

options.name: service_account_contents
options.description: The contents of a Service Account JSON file, either in a dictionary or as a JSON string that represents it.

options.name: service_account_email
options.description: An optional service account email address if machineaccount is selected and the user does not wish to use the default email.

options.name: service_account_file
options.description: The path of a Service Account JSON file if serviceaccount is selected as type.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the given object should exist in GCP

options.name: time_zone
options.description: Specifies the time zone to be used in interpreting schedule. The value of this field must be a time zone name from the tz database.
